parsed_resultsets.statement: SELECT VERSION() AS server_version, DATABASE() AS test_schema,        @@SESSION.windowing_use_high_precision AS initial_high_precision
SELECT 'WIN01_DEC_FORWARD' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_dec) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN02_REAL_FORWARD_INVERSE' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_real) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN03_REAL_FORWARD_PRECISE' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_real) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN04_DEC_CURRENT' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_dec) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN05_REAL_CURRENT' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_real) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN06_DEC_BOUNDED' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_dec) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN07_REAL_BOUNDED' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_real) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN08_DEC_CUMULATIVE_CONTROL' AS case_id
SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_dec) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY g,id
SELECT 'WIN09_VALUE_FUNCTIONS' AS case_id

SELECT g,id,CAST(AVG(v_dec) OVER w AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS avg_v,        FIRST_VALUE(v_dec) OVER w AS first_v,        LAST_VALUE(v_dec) OVER w AS last_v,        NTH_VALUE(v_dec,2) OVER w AS second_v FROM wf_c296_values WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY g,id
